# How to use Kubernetes Monitoring dashboards

This demonstration video highlights the Grafana Kubernetes Monitoring pre-built dashboard, focusing on its capabilities for managing clusters, nodes, namespaces, and workloads. It begins with a default view that displays all relevant information, with filtering options for more focused insights on resources like node and pod counts, CPU, memory utilization, and current alerts. The dashboard facilitates easy navigation and provides detailed views for troubleshooting issues effectively. Each section allows you to sort and filter data, enabling efficient identification of high utilization patterns and errors.
